capability.summary: Cost-efficient multimodal generalist for text, reasoning, coding, tool use, and visual understanding.
capability.problem_space: General-purpose multimodal model for text reasoning, code generation, structured generation, tool-assisted analysis, and visual understanding. Accepts text and image input and produces text output. External tools execute outside the model. Current gateway capability and comparative quality require independent Linux verification.

env_requirements: Valid API Key (Cloud) or High-Memory GPU with Multimodal Support
constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text, image | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.

semantic_review.task_profile_basis: Broad task categories are registration metadata, not an empirical ranking or fixed framework role.
semantic_review.context_policy: The configured context label is preserved separately from gateway verification.

model_distinction_review.interpretation_limit: The attached local protocol pass establishes point-in-time usability only; Linux health and paired task comparisons determine active retention.
model_distinction_review.scope: Broad low-price baseline for the bounded Qwen retention comparison.

provenance.pricing_note: Official reference rates and backend billing rules from the same dated pricebook; capability and gateway evidence unchanged.
